name: Isobar
author: atsokolas
description: The weather, drawn in your theme — a sky that moves, a forecast in a sentence, and the next 24 hours at a glance.

barWidget.description: The sky and the temperature on the bar; the day ahead in the panel.

schema.label: Units
schema.description: Automatic follows your locale: °F and mph in the US, °C and km/h elsewhere.

schema.label: Rain hint on the bar
schema.description: "Rain in 20m" beside the temperature, only when it's coming.

schema.label: Heads-up before rain
schema.description: A quiet toast half an hour before rain or snow arrives.

schema.label: Moving sky
schema.description: Rays turn and rain falls while you hover or the panel is open.
